neighbours.label: The token just before 'half' or '50%' in a definition of a statistical cut-off (median, LD50, EC50, middle 50%); promotes half and percentile. The same statistical nouns without the definition stay quiet
fire: The median home price means that half of all sales fall below this figure.
IC50 is the concentration that inhibits half of the enzyme activity.
The half-life is the time required to lose half of the activity.
By definition, the median splits a sample so that half of the values lie above it.
The lowest quartile earned under $20,000, and the middle 50% earned up to $60,000.
The LD50 is the amount that kills 50% of the test mice.
Median survival is the time at which half of the patients have died.
The ED50 is the dose that produces an effect in half of the subjects.
quiet: The median home price rose sharply in the northern suburbs last spring.
The enzyme activity was measured at room temperature in the lab.
The drug's half-life was reported in the second table of the paper.
By definition, a sample is a small portion of a population.
The lowest quartile was drawn in red on the chart beside the table.
The mice were given the amount in their morning feed.
Patients who died were buried near the old hospital.
She split the cake and gave half of it to the subjects of her study.

short: token before half in stat definitions
